title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Is this a fair take on Brad
“Ausmus should do better in his second stint. The clubhouse will be a cakewalk compared to those in Detroit. His baseball knowledge isn’t a question; his leadership skills are.”
He should do better because he has experience now not because The Ángels clubhouse is a cake walk compared to the Tigers. I can explain to help you. I just called you.
I’m on a flight to Paris
I am going to Malta, where I’m from
Yeah, I’m very excited. See you in San Diego
Ausmus learned on the job how to deal with Veteran players. It was not just VMart. He made mistakes he knows and is smart enough to make adjustments.
I agree. I still do not know if he has that “it” factor
